top_choice_rationale: P001 honours a mature, repeatedly confirmed discovery: a Z2 time-reversal-invariant topological insulator and quantum spin Hall state predicted by Kane and Mele and observed by Molenkamp in HgTe wells, with a testable prediction that could have failed. The narrow 2D citation naming HgTe gives a coherent three-name boundary, and the 2016 prize covered broken-time-reversal topology, so it is distinct. The BHZ and Zhang attribution gap is real but is mitigated by the wording. P002 is a robust, reproduced advance with a clean two-name credit, but its novelty relative to the 2005 and 2012 prizes is unresolved and its output so far is constraints, so it ranks second. No award ranks last because a ripe discovery is available.
recusal_note: Director of WACQT and close to the Chalmers superconducting-circuit community (B020), which is not in this slate; no connection to Kane, Mele, Molenkamp, Katori or Ye apparent from profile.
